CustomBgm.rationale: Audio only: CombatManager.cs is the sole non-Models reader. No sim audio layer.

RoomType.rationale: TheInsatiableBoss.cs:11 RoomType => Boss. 'the_insatiable' sits in hive's boss_keys only. Cross-ref seam/rooms_and_map for the runtime resolution mechanism.

HasCustomBackground.rationale: TheInsatiableBoss.cs:13 => true, a rendering-asset choice (EncounterModel.cs:293-308) consumed only by preload paths. No sim scene/background renderer.

AmbientSfx.rationale: TheInsatiableBoss.cs:15 sets a custom ambience track. Readers (ActModel.cs, the Acts/*.cs files, NRunMusicController.cs) are all audio-layer; no gameplay/RNG consumer. No sim audio layer.

AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: Presentation/bestiary only (ActModel.cs:169, NBestiary.cs:194). C# value is [TheInsatiable] (1 element), matching GenerateMonsters' roster. No sim per-encounter vocabulary counterpart.

GetCameraScaling.rationale: Camera-only (0.9f, NCombatRoom.cs). No sim camera. (TheInsatiableBoss does not override GetCameraOffset, so that member is not a declared hook here.)

GenerateMonsters.rationale: TheInsatiableBoss.cs:24-27 returns a fixed single-element list, (TheInsatiable, null) -- roster {TheInsatiable}x1, slot null, ZERO Rng draws. Encounter.create_monsters (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) matches exactly: roster, order (trivial) and draw count (0) identical.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: EncounterModel.cs:39 => false. The sim's Encounter object is never registered with the HookSystem; only TheInsatiable registers itself. Matches C#.

guards.rationale: Not overridden; inherits Boss => (100, 100), matching sts2_rl/rewards.py GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.BOSS] exactly (`py audit/tools/encounter_probes_e4.py gold-ladder`). Poverty out of scope per PROMPT.md.
Neither overridden. THE_INSATIABLE_BOSS passes no should_give_rewards= (default True); 'the_insatiable' is absent from every weak_keys tuple, matching IsWeak=>false.
GenerateMonsters draws ZERO values on either side -- no draw here to misattribute to a shared stream.
